subject: house:stark
quote: “The King in the North!” he said, kneeling beside the Greatjon.
note: Robb is proclaimed King in the North; the North no longer holds of the Iron Throne. Show: the wiki's Fire and Blood (TV) page, "proclaim Robb as The King in the North".

subject: house:tully
quote: Eddard Stark’s son has been proclaimed King in the North, with all the power of Winterfell and Riverrun behind him.
note: The river lords' oath is first told plainly here (AGOT ends with Robb's crowning, not their oath).

subject: Winterfell
quote: I promise you, Winterfell is mine.
note: Theon takes Winterfell.

subject: Moat Cailin
quote: Deepwood fallen, Moat Cailin, soon Torrhen’s Square.
note: First told that the ironmen have taken the Moat (ACOK Bran VI only says Victarion sails to seize it).

subject: Winterfell
quote: Bran said, “I saw Winterfell burning.”
note: Ramsay's men sack and burn Winterfell and leave it empty.

subject: Harrenhal
quote: When Lord Tywin went to Harrenhal, Bolton took the ruby ford and the crossroads.
note: Tywin's host holds Harrenhal; House Whent is left with nothing of it.

subject: Harrenhal
quote: Lord Bolton is giving Harrenhal to the Bloody Mummers
note: Roose Bolton holds Harrenhal after Tywin marches on King's Landing.

subject: house:frey
quote: She saw Lucas Blackwood cut down by Ser Hosteen Frey.
note: The Red Wedding: the Freys turn on their king and go over to the Iron Throne.

subject: house:bolton
quote: Jaime Lannister sends his regards.
note: Roose Bolton kills Robb for the Iron Throne.

subject: Moat Cailin
quote: if you yield Moat Cailin to him before the sun goes down
note: The ironborn yield the Moat to Ramsay in this chapter.

subject: Winterfell
quote: Lord Bolton had Winterfell sewn up tight as a babe’s swaddling clothes.
note: Late on purpose: the Boltons reach Winterfell in The Prince of Winterfell; this is the first line found that says they hold it.

subject: Combat at the Tower of Joy
Battle in the waters off Gulltown
Battle of the Gullet
source: wiki: Battle_of_the_Gullet (infobox Date: 5th day of the 1st moon of 130 AC)

subject: Battle Above the Gods Eye
source: wiki: Battle_Above_the_Gods_Eye (infobox Date: 22nd day of the 5th moon of 130 AC)

subject: Battle of Oxcross
quote: Six nights gone, your brother fell upon my uncle Stafford, encamped with his host at a village called Oxcross not three days ride from Casterly Rock.
note: First reported by Joffrey to Sansa; fought off-page. Every other Oxcross mention (Bran V, Catelyn V) comes later.

subject: Battle at Duskendale
quote: Yesterday at dawn our brave Lord Randyll caught Robett Glover outside Duskendale and trapped him against the sea.
note: First reported at the small council. ASOS Tyrion I only has the northmen marching toward Duskendale, before the battle.

subject: Fighting at Bitterbridge
quote: Lord Tarly has seized Renly’s stores and put a great many to the sword; Florents, chiefly.
note: First reported by Littlefinger. Tyrion VIII's 'fighting between here and Bitterbridge' is fighting on the road, not at the camp.

subject: Fighting at Sow's Horn
quote: At a place called Sow’s Horn they found a tough old knight named Ser Roger Hogg squatting stubbornly in his towerhouse with six men-at-arms, four crossbowmen, and a score of peasants.
note: Hogg tells Jaime about the fight with the Karstark 'wolves'. This is the only place Sow's Horn is named in the novels; ASOS Catelyn III only has the Karstark hunt that led to it.

subject: Fight at Torrhen's Square
quote: Dagmer’s lost the fight at Torrhen’s Square
note: First reported to Theon. Bran VI earlier only has the castle under attack, not the fight that broke Dagmer.

subject: Fight by Deepwood Motte
quote: From beyond Deepwood’s mossy wooden walls came the sudden sound of trumpets.
note: Fought on the page from Asha's view. Reek III (ch 32), Jon VI and VII, and Davos IV all report it later; Jon IV (ch 17) only has the plan.

subject: Fight at the Fist
quote: all about the camp the brothers of the Night’s Watch were rising, donning their armor
note: The attack begins on the page: the horn blows three times for Others. No ACOK chapter has it; Samwell I (ASOS-18) has the rest of the fight.

subject: Fight at the Bridge of Skulls
quote: At the Bridge of Skulls he had met the Weeper and three hundred wildlings and won a bloody battle.
note: First reported, about Bowen Marsh; fought off-page. The earlier ASOS mentions of the Gorge are Bowen's pursuit, not the fight.

subject: Fighting in the Hornwood
quote: Roose Bolton’s bastard had started it by seizing Lady Hornwood as she returned from the harvest feast
note: The trouble is first reported here: Ramsay seizes Lady Hornwood, Manderly takes her castle, Rodrik rides east. Bran V (ch 35) is the first explicit 'killing one another in Hornwood forests'.

subject: Battle in the hills below the Golden Tooth
quote: Less than a fortnight past, they fought a battle in the hills below the Golden Tooth,
note: First reported. Earlier lines (Catelyn VII, Eddard XI) only have Vance and Piper guarding the pass, before the battle.

subject: Battle of the Camps
quote: what madness made Ser Jaime decide to split his men into three separate camps?
note: First reported to Tywin's council. Catelyn X (ch 63) only has the Blackfish's plan, and Catelyn XI (ch 71) has the aftermath.

subject: Battle under the walls of Riverrun
quote: He smashed the Lords Vance and Piper at the Golden Tooth, and met the massed power of the Tullys under the walls of Riverrun.
note: First reported, along with Edmure's capture, before Catelyn IX's 'There has been a battle under the walls of Riverrun'.

subject: Battle of the Blackwater
quote: The battle is begun
note: The battle starts in this chapter (enemy sails sighted, 'The battle is begun'), one chapter before the river fight in Davos III (ch 58).

subject: Battle of the Fords
quote: Lord Tywin had tried to force a crossing at a dozen different fords, her brother wrote, but every thrust had been thrown back.
note: First reported in Edmure's letter, along with Stone Mill. Catelyn III (ch 31) is only the plan to defend the fords.

subject: Fighting at the fords of the Trident
quote: Ser Wylis rallied our men as best he could, but Gregor Clegane attacked with heavy horse and drove them into the river.
note: First reported, in Roose Bolton's message about Gregor attacking the rear guard.

subject: Attack on Castle Black
quote: Styr had lost all hope of taking Castle Black unawares when Jon escaped him
note: Fought on the page: the Thenns burn Mole's Town and attack. Mance's assault on the gate (Jon IX) comes later.

subject: Battle beneath the Wall
quote: when the trumpets blew again and the knights charged, the name they cried was
note: Fought on the page: Stannis's charge smashes Mance's host. Nothing earlier.

subject: Battle outside the gates of Winterfell
quote: With a bloody man on their banner.
note: Fought on the page: Ramsay's Dreadfort men fall on Rodrik's host. Nothing earlier.

subject: Battle near Yunkai
quote: The Stormcrows turned their cloaks, the slaves broke, and the Second Sons were too drunk to fight, just as you said.
note: Fought in this chapter (the night attack outside Yunkai). Nothing earlier.

subject: Battle on Whispering Sound
quote: Battle here
note: Sam sees the wrecks and Xhondo says 'Battle here'. Earlier, Cersei VIII (AFFC-36) only reports longships being sent up the Sound, not a battle.

subject: Battle on the Green Fork
quote: They trotted past blackened fields and burned holdfasts, down to the riverlands and the Green Fork of the Trident.
note: Fought on the page with Tyrion. Earlier chapters (Catelyn VIII) only have the march.

subject: Battle at Mummer's Ford
quote: Lord Derik had no sooner crossed the Red Fork than the Lannisters fell upon him, the king’s banner be damned, and Gregor Clegane took them in the rear as they tried to pull back across the Mummer’s Ford.
note: First reported, about Beric's force. Eddard XI's Mummer's Ford lines are Gregor's earlier raid on the village, not this battle.
